roles.description: Who the rule places its duty on
roles.title: Roles

if.description: Every situational condition under which the rule applies (when it applies, never a role and never what must be done); empty list if none
if.title: If

then.description: What the rule requires to be done when it applies
then.title: Then

exceptions.description: Situations the rule itself names in which it does not apply; empty list if none
exceptions.title: Exceptions
